children: Fermi posted a fact sheet disclosing a binding 15-year phase one lease with TensorWave worth $6.5B over the initial term.
Binding 15-year phase one lease for 222 MW total power capacity, with occupancy phased from Q4 2027.
Phase one contracted revenue of $6.5B over the 15-year initial term; two 5-year renewal options and 2.5% annual escalators.
Lease backed by AMD credit support beginning after construction completion and rent commencement.
Estimated phase one project NOI margin ~75%–80%; natural gas and variable power charges passed through to tenant.
Unit cost guidance: $3–4M per MW of total power capacity; $10–12M per MW of critical IT capacity; 156 MW critical IT capacity.
